statement: (V : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (x y : V) : 0 ≤ Matrix.det !![inner ℝ x x, inner ℝ x y; inner ℝ y x, inner ℝ y y]
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (x y : V), 0 ≤ Matrix.det !![inner ℝ x x, inner ℝ x y; inner ℝ y x, inner ℝ y y]
informal: The 2×2 Gram determinant of two vectors in a real inner product space is nonnegative — expand with det_fin_two; it is Cauchy–Schwarz ⟨x,y⟩² ≤ ⟨x,x⟩⟨y,y⟩ plus symmetry of the inner product.
